prompt: A photorealistic photo captures the interior of a vintage train dining car. On the left, an elderly woman in a blue hat sits on a velvet bench, her posture upright and dignified. Beside her, a silver teapot rests on the white tablecloth, gleaming under the overhead lights. In the center, a waiter in a black vest stands holding a tray, his gaze fixed on a young man in a grey suit who is seated across from him. The young man in the grey suit points at a menu lying open on the table, indicating his choice. Next to the menu, a glass of red wine sits half-full, its contents swirling slightly. To the right, a couple shares a booth; the woman in a yellow dress looks at the man in a green tie, who is smiling warmly at her. Between them, a plate of steak and potatoes steams gently, the aroma almost visible in the still air. Behind the couple, a large window reveals a blurred landscape rushing by, emphasizing the motion of the train. A small potted fern sits on the windowsill, adding a touch of greenery to the scene. Near the aisle, a brown leather suitcase stands upright, suggesting recent travel. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the carriage. There is no plastic cutlery present on any of the tables.
